annotation_method: Codex visual review of original non-GolfDB contact sheets; one reviewer, exploratory labels, not ground truth. Source frame indices are zero-based. Club reversal/contact brackets reflect visual uncertainty. Windows include a short address and finish hold; they are not GolfDB Address/Finish event definitions.

il-ban.notes: First real-time swing. Slow replay starts at the cut between f161 and f163; additional replay follows around f465. Full video is not one swing.

pro.notes: A complete DTL swing; fade/cut around f354-364 then face-on address and another swing. Brackets are deliberately coarse from f10-step contact sheet.

pro2.notes: Contains one complete swing before dissolve around f3830. Auto window starts near top and continues into next backswing. Manual onset is coarse; refinement sheet included.

pexels_8065880.notes: Slow-looking playback; duration is media time, not inferred physical swing duration.

pexels_6541855.notes: Slow-looking playback; finish changes after the initial hold.

pexels_35546329.notes: S2/S3 red-shirt video visually identified by person, scenery, clothes and club. Exact original user trim metadata unavailable; default auto crop reproduced separately.

pexels_34883764.notes: Difficult small golfer, short chip; several earlier practice motions at about 3 and 7 seconds. Actual shot judged by ball displacement; no conventional full-height backswing.
